question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.

You must be quite **__good acquainted__** with the terrain in this jungle.
solution:
the correct answer is **''well acquainted"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the chosen option:
 
 
• **Well acquainted**- having a good knowledge of something:
 
 
 
• Look at some examples:
 
 
• I am **well acquainted** with German Cities.
 
• She is well **acquainted with **her car.
 
 
 
• Let's analyse the sentence.
 
 
• "You must be quite well** __**acquainted with the terrain in this jungle" means "you must have knowledge of the terrain of this jungle"
 
 
 
• Hence, the right answer will be: *You must be quite __**well**____** acquainted**__ with the terrain in this jungle. *
